Commentary.Commentary: Right! It is not a massive total but Australia have not been in the best form with the bat. They struggled in the first match and gave away the game from the winning position. England will remember that and try to force something similar. Stay tuned for the run chase.
England would be terribly disappointed with the way they batted but would now hope to put in a better performance with the ball to put that behind and look to sweep the series.

After some hitting after the Powerplay, Australia came back well and started applying the pressure right back on the hosts. Their bowling at the death was nothing less than outstanding - England could muster just 35 in the last 5.

For the Australians, Starc and Hazlewood started off on a really appreciable note. They got Banton towards the end of the second over and kept a tight lid on the scoring rate, leading into the end of the Powerplay. England were literally struggling and their only succour was Bairstow's half ton. He too though consumed a fair amount of deliveries, but that is in many ways fair, as no English batter was ticking the scoreboard.

Excellent last couple of overs from Australia, they restrict England to 145, which is the lowest of all the three games so far. Aaron Finch would be pretty happy with the way the bowlers have bowled today. And now, it is upto the batters to finish the task without any hitches.
Only a run! What a fine over from Richardson. Very full and around off, pushed through mid off for a run by Curran. ENGLAND FINISH WITH 145/6.
Missed away! It  is a bad ball. It is on the  pads of Curran. He whacks hard but only connects with the thin air as the ball kisses his pad and goes behind.
Just a run! Excellent over so far. Full and outside off, Denly looks to slam it through the off side but the ball hits the toe end of the willow and goes towards the cover fielder. Single taken.
Shortish and around middle, Curran can only get a run as he strokes it towards long on.
Fuller and around middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.

OUT! CAUGHT! Good length ball outside off, Jordan looks to power it over the long on fence via a pull. He doesn't get the desired timing and the ball goes high in the air. Steven Smith at long on moves across to his left and takes a good catch.
A single to end! Fuller and around off, Jordan drives it well but can't beat mid off. Only a run.

Ouch! That's on the helmet. Starc sees Denly trying to open up the off side by moving to his left and follows him with a sharp bouncer. Denly looks to pull but misses to get hit on the helmet. The ball rolls towards the off side and they change end. The umpire deems it as a run which means he might have got some bat or gloves on it. As the ball has thudded the helmet, the England physio walks out to check with Denly. Concussion test is mandatory regardless of the situation these days. That's done now and we are ready to begin.

Excellent yorker! Jordan does well to dig it out towards mid-wicket. Starc has to go after the ball. They think for the second but Starc is quick, very quick to get to the ball and keeps it down to just one.
Another single! Good first three balls from Starc. It is a low full toss on middle and leg, Denly strokes it towards long on for a run.
Fuller and around off, this one is lofted over cover-point. Only a run.
Good length ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and on middle and leg, Jordan flicks it towards fine leg for a run. Excellent over for England. 16 off it.
Fuller and around off, it is pushed towards the mid off region for a quick run.

FOUR! Edgy this time but Denly won't mind. Third boundary in the over. It is another slower one. Denly goes hard this time but gets a thick outside edge. The ball once again teases Wade to his right and goes to the third man fence.
FOUR! Nicely done! Another slower one from Richardson. This time Denly spots it early, waits for the ball and then guides it through the vacant slip cordon. The ball races to the fence at third man.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller and around off, Denly looks to hack it on the leg side but the ball takes the inside edge and races to the fine leg fence past diving Wade.
Shortish and on middle, Denly pulls it towards deep square leg and scampers back for a couple. Had to delay the shot as the ball came really slowly.
Dot to end an excellent over! Full and around off, pushed towards the cover fielder.

OUT! CAUGHT! Steve Smith at deep square leg juggles but takes the catch in the end. It was a slower ball, Moeen looked to take the longest part of the boundary but could not quite get the distance. Steve Smith watches and watches and gets underneath and takes it. But is he inside the ropes? The umpires want to have a look at that. The soft signal though is out. The third umpire is called in and repeated set of replays show nothing conclusive to not declare that as out. So, it is a legitimate catch and Moeen has to make the long walk back now.
Full and on middle, stroked through mid on for a run
Very full and on middle, swinging in, Moeen flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and around off, comes back in a bit as Moeen misses his slog.
Full and on middle, pushed through the cover for a run.
Floats this outside off, Moeen works this past the bowler and to the right of long off for a couple.
Quicker one on off, worked past point for one.
Misses! Fires a shorter one down the leg side, Denly makes room and looks to cut but misses.
Shortish on the leg pole line, Ali works this to the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, lofted over point for a single.
Flatter outside off from round the wicket. Cut past point for one.

FOUR! Miscued but it still reached the boundary. Tossed up wide outside off, Denly chips down and looks to go big over the off side. He though ends up slicing it high but well over wide long off for a boundary. Zampa finishes with 4-0-34-2
Around off on a fuller length, it is slower than the other balls of the over. Denly skips down the track and looks to hammer it inside over but is not to the pitch of the ball.
Tossed up on middle, Moeen works it through square leg for an easy run now.
SIX! Slammed away! Moeen gives it a charge and connects. Floated around off and middle, Moeen skips down the track and powers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Goes short and Denly punches it through point for a run.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Full and outside off, Moeen looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball goes towards short third man who makes a half stop which is not good enough for the ball to stop. It goes to the fence eventually.
Darted around off, pushed towards the left side of the bowler who dives and saves a single.
Darted around off, pushed towards the left side of the bowler who dives and saves a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Agar gets the dangerous Bairstow. That was an excellent catch, there was no fielder there and Agar had to run all the way to short mid-wicket to take that one. Flatter ball on off, Bairstow comes down and looked to loft that over deep-midwicket for a maximum. He though gets a top edge and the ball went sky-high on top of short mid-wicket. Agar runs in and pouches on to that safely.
Floated on middle and leg, Moeen skips down the track and looks to flick but misses. There is an appeal but not out says the umpire.
Short and outside off, Bairstow looks to cut but the ball bounces a bit more and hits the upper part of the bat and goes towards the off side. Single taken.
Around middle, watchfully blocked out. Dot to end the over.
Full and around middle, swept powerfully to the left of Kane Richardson at deep square leg for one.
Ashton Agar back in.

SIX! Mighty! And it bring up Bairstow's half ton as well. Well fought half ton in the midst of trying times. Bairstow comes down the track and lofts this mightily to the empty stands behind long off for a maximum.
Moeen comes down and works the flatter ball to long on for one.
Googly on off, Bairstow mistimes the slog sweep, it goes to Richo at deep square leg. Just the single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to cover.
Sharp bouncer to end the over! After getting hit for a boundary on the last ball, Hazlewood bangs one more ball short and around off, Moeen this time does well to sway away.
FOUR! Up and over! Nicely done! Hazlewood bowls a short ball around off, asking Moeen to pull or hook. The left-hander though stays on the back foot and just upper cuts it into the third man fence.
On the pads, Bairstow looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball rolls on the leg side and they take a leg bye.
Rotates the strike this time, does Ali, as he guides this fuller ball around off towards third man.
Fuller and around off, blocked.
Good length ball around off, Moeen pushes it towards the off side and thinks for a single but is sent back.
Josh Hazlewood is back in the attack. 3-0-18-1 are his figures.
Tossed up around off, Bairstow doesn't go after it and pushes it towards the cover fielder calmly. 8 runs and a wicket from the over.
Fuller and just around off, Moeen pushes it through point to get a run.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Moeen Ali is the new man in at the crease for England. He has a considerable task on his shoulders.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zampa has another one! Excellent catch from Finch. Zampa bowls a slower one, it is fuller and just around off, Billings looks to reverse sweep but all he ends up doing it is get some bat and the ball flies to the right side of Finch at first slip. Finch there does well to leap to that side and take a good catch. Excellent bowling from Zampa. Good dip and bounce from Zampa there. Poor from Billings as he throws away the chance.
Short and around off, cut towards the point fielder for a quick run.
SIX! MIGHTY! What a strike! Bairstow on the charge against the spinners! Zamps tosses this around off, Bairstow bends on his back leg and slogs it way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a huge six.

Slower through the air and around off, Billings tucks it towards the leg side. He takes the first run and probably sees the fielder is slow getting to the ball. Goes for the second. The fielder fires the throw and scores a direct hit but Billings is in. A couple in the end, to the total.
Very full on middle, it is stroked through mid on for a run.
Short and outside off, Bairstow cuts hard but finds the cover fielder.
SIX! Slammed away! Tossed up on middle, Bairstoe skips down the track and nails it over the deep mid-wicket fence f or a biggie.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs
Full and on middle, it is in the slot. Bairstow looks to slam it on the leg side powerfully but fails to connect.
Bairstow pushes this past covers for one.
Flatter ball, tucked away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Bairstow works this against the spin, to mid-wicket for one.
Billings is off the mark. Pushes this floated delivery past covers for one.
Sam Billings will look to make the most of the chance that he has got here. With more than 11  overs left, he has got plenty of time as well.
Bairstow works this flatter ball to the leg side for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zampa strikes immediately. The dangerous Malan has to walk back now. Floated on middle, Malan looked to go big on the leg side. He though ends up getting a top edge and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. Stoinis runs in, dives and takes a good catch to send Malan back.
Adam Zampa in the attack.
A couple to end an excellent over for England. Short and around off, Bairstow punches it through point and gets two more.

FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Another one which is shortish, quicker and outside off, Bairstow goes back and cuts it between short third man and backward point. It is uppish but in the gap. 50 up for the hosts.
Shortish and around off, Bairstow goes back and cuts but can't beat the short third man.
Follows the boundary with a single by pushing this fuller ball towards long on.
FOUR! Goes the other way of sweeping and fetches a boundary. Agar bowls it on middle, Malan sits down and reverse sweeps it through cover-point to get a boundary.
Saved two! Good work in the deep! Full and on middle, Malan sweeps it wide  of the deep square leg fielder. Hazlewood there hares and does well to flick it in. Two taken.
Spin time! Ashton Agar is into the attack now.
Swings hard but mistimes it. Fuller and on middle, Malan looks to hack it on the leg side but doesn't time it well. The ball goes towards long on for a run.
Slower one around off, Bairstow reads it well and pushes it towards short third man for a quick run.
On middle, it is worked towards the leg side for a run.
Now cuts this short ball to deep cover to get to the other end. Moves to 20 off 22.
Punched nicely! Shortish and just outside off, Bairstow goes back and punches it through the cover region. A couple more for Bairstow.
Good length ball around off, Malan taps it towards short third man who dives to his right to save runs. Single taken.
Dot to end the Powerplay as Bairstow pushes it towards mid off. 33/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Looks to work it on the leg side this time but gets hit high on the pads.
FOUR! Times this one all right, does Bairstow. Short and on middle and leg, Bairstow once again swings hard and this time he connects and finds the gap in the deep on the leg side.

FOUR! Not from the middle again but England and Bairstow will take it. Fuller and around middle and leg, Bairstow looks to whack it on the leg side but gets a thick inside edge. The ball goes past the short fine leg fielder and races to the fence.
NO BALL! Full and around off. Jonny makes room and drills it straight to mid off. Hazlewood has overstepped so he has to re-bowl this ball. Free Hit coming up.

Huge appeal! Massive appeal but once again not out says the umpire. A shortish ball on middle and leg, Bairstow looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. They all go up in appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Short and on middle, Malan pulls it towards deep square leg. Doesn't time it well. A single as it goes to the fielder on bounce.
Short length delivery again, Bairstow pulls to deep square leg this time and gets a couple.
Bairstow connects the pull this time, but straight to the man at square leg. A dot.
Short length ball on top of off and middle, Bairswto looks to pull but misses it completely.
Bairstow looks to scoop this over fine leg but misses.
Short and around off, Bairstow goes for the pull once again but mistimes it towards the man at mid-wicket.
Short and on off and middle, Bairstow pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Kane Richardson is into the attack now.
Bairstow pulls the shorter length ball but straight to deep square leg. Just a single.
This time he drives this fuller ball to mid on and takes a quick single.
Bouncer outside off, Malan attempts to get bat on ball but misses completely.
FOUR! Pretty good bumper from Hazlewood but he was unlucky there that the ball went away for four! Malan pulls this bumper behind square and well to the left of the short fine leg fielder for four.
Works this fuller length ball to the man at mid on.
Malan advances and looks to loft this on the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the top of his pads. THe ball rolls to the off side off the deflection.
A single to end as Malan works this on the off side for one. 9 off the over.
WIDE! Bowls a full length delivery down the leg side. Malan looked to help it on its way but misses. Wide called.
In the air but lands well short of the man at mid off. Full length ball on off, Malan lofts this a touch uppishly towards mid off. The ball goes to the fielder there on a bounce.
FOUR! Easy picking for Malan and there was no fielder there to stop that. Shortish and on the hip, Malan tucks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Shortish length ball on top of off, Malan defends it out.

Full and around off, Bairstow drives that well past mid off. The ball does not have enough to reach the boundary though and the mid off fielder gives chase and dives towards the end and keep it away from rolling into the fence. Replays roll in and confirm that Kane did well to keep that in. Three taken.
Fullish outside off, Bairstow defends it out from within the crease.
Dawid Malan walks out to bat now. He is in a brilliant form in this format of the game. Can he deliver one more time for England?
Length ball on the pads, Malan looked to play at that but gets it high on the thigh pad instead.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hazlewood is a class bowler, gets the breakthrough immediately. Tom Banton, looking to go big right away. Got to give yourself some time to settle down. Haste makes waste. Fullish length ball outside off, swinging away, Banton swings at that wildly. He misses to connect the way he would have liked and the ball takes an outside edge and goes to Wade at a comfortable catching height. He takes it safely.
Short length delivery from Hazlewood this time, Bairstow looks to pull but does not time it well. The ball dribbles away to square leg for one.
A dot as the fuller length delivery is driven to mid off.
Short of a length just outside off, Jonny pushes this to cover.
Full on the stumps, Tom closes the face of his bat to work this to square leg for one.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Bouncer, Jonny ducks under it to let it through. 2 runs off Starc's first over.
Jonny drives this length ball straight to the man at cover.
WIDE! On a length down the leg side, Bairstow lets it be. Wided by the umpire.
Banton is off the mark. Drives this fuller length ball to wide mid off for one.

NOT OUT! An inside edge and Banton stays. Full length ball on the pads, swinging away a touch as well. Gets the pads of Banton as he looked to turn that on the leg side. Starc appeals, this time more fervently. The umpire is still unfazed and this time Australia decide to take it upstairs. However, their hopes are dashed as there is an iniside edge there.
Australia take the review! They want to review a LBW decision which went against them. Banton is the man in question. UltraEdge comes in and it shows that there is an inside edge there.
Starc appeal for a LBW but it was going down leg. Good length ball on the pads, Tom looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Starc appeals but in vain.
Starc starts off with a length ball outside off, Tom lets it be.
The English openers make their way out to the middle. Tom Banton will open along with Bairstow, as Buttler is not playing today. Mitchell Starc to begin with the ball for Australia. Off we go then!

Moeen Ali, the English skipper, says that he is proud and that it is an absolute honour to captain his country. States that it is a big responsibility to fill Morgan's shoes and that he looks forward to the same. On the bio bubble and its challenges, Moeen says that England is fortunate to have played some cricket and therefore are better acclimatized to the same. Says that he is looking forward to win this game.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, wants to bowl first and believes that it is a pretty good wicket to do so. Says that he wants to chase under the lights today. Adds that it has been a challenge this series and believes that some small patches have cost them the games. As an approach, he says that sometimes individual approaches work better than a whole-based approach. States that he expects his boys to be good with the bat and the ball this game.
England (Playing XI) - Tom Banton, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Dawid Malan, Sam Billings, Moeen Ali (C), Joe Denly, Tom Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Matthew Wade (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Steven Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Mitchell Marsh, Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
Toss - Moeen Ali will lead England as Morgan is unavailable due to an injury that he picked up in the last game. Up goes the coin and Australia win the toss. THEY WILL FIELD FIRST!

So, the last T20I between these two, before we move to the ODIs and there is lot to play for, as far as both teams are concerned. For England, they would look at effecting a clean sweep and take the No.1 position in the T20I rankings. They though will have to contend without Buttler, who has opted out of the last game due to private reasons. For Australia, winning the game would be important to avoid an ignominious whitewash and to keep their No.1 position safe. They would be hoping the batting to come good this time as it would be important if they want to win this game. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and the teams...
